description: This file declares functions and constants for managing grant table operations in a Xen environment within Zephyr OS, including grant access, allocation, mapping, and error handling.

methods.name: gnttab_grant_access
methods.description: Assigns a grant reference and permits access to a 4K page for a specific domain.

methods.name: gnttab_end_access
methods.description: Ends access to a previously shared grant, without freeing memory.

methods.name: gnttab_alloc_and_grant
methods.description: Allocates a 4K page for a grant and shares it, returning a grant reference.

methods.name: gnttab_get_page
methods.description: Provides a free page for mapping foreign frames.

methods.name: gnttab_put_page
methods.description: Releases a page used for mapping foreign grant frames.

methods.name: gnttab_map_refs
methods.description: Maps foreign grant references into Zephyr address space.

methods.name: gnttab_unmap_refs
methods.description: Unmaps foreign grant references from Zephyr address space.

methods.name: gnttabop_error
methods.description: Converts grant ref status codes to text messages.
